c74object.name: evi_logattackdecay
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Attack/decay envelope follower
c74object.description:
evi_logattackdecay is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
Logarithmic attack/decay envelope follower / smoother.

geninlet.name: value
geninlet.digest: to Follow. evi_logattackdecay will follow this input value with the given attack and decay times.

geninlet.name: attack
geninlet.digest: Time in milliseconds @min 0. Amount of time the envelope takes to attack. evi_logattackdecay is logarithmic and does not attack in this time exactly.

geninlet.name: decay
geninlet.digest: Time in milliseconds @min 0. Amount of time the envelope takes to decay. evi_logattackdecay is logarithmic and does not decay in this time exactly.
